resources.name: α-Fe2O3 (hematite) bulk crystal structure

access.notes: Alternatively available from Crystallography Open Database (COD ID 1000032).

resources.notes: Bulk hematite structure (rhombohedral, a=b≈5.04 Å, c≈13.72 Å) for constructing the O3-terminated (0001) slab model.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO
resources.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code with support for DFT+U, geometry optimization, NEB, and dimer transition-state searches. Used as the primary computational engine.

resources.name: PBE pseudopotentials (Fe, O, Ir, C)
resources.notes: Standard pseudopotential library (SSSP efficiency or PSLibrary) providing PAW/PBE pseudopotentials for all required elements.
